# Ferrotech Engineering LLC

> Manufacturer of electro-forged steel gratings, heavy duty gratings, stair treads, FRP/GRP gratings, access engineering products and structural steel in Sohar Industrial Estate, Sultanate of Oman. Part of the Ferrotech group (Ferrograte brand since 2002). ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 14001:2015.

Contact: info@ferrotechengg.com, +968 2450 2841, +968 9986 3383. Languages: English.

## Products
- [Electro-forged steel gratings](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/gratings/electro-forged/): BS 4592-1 and ANSI/NAAMM MBG531-00, load bar 25-80 mm, standard panel 1 m x 7.315 m
- [Heavy duty gratings](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/gratings/heavy-duty/): load bar up to 150 mm for rolling loads
- [Stair treads](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/gratings/stair-treads/)
- [FRP / GRP gratings](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/gratings/frp/)
- [Structural steel fabrication](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/structural/): 15,000 m2 plot, 3,200 m2 covered shed, 4,200 MT per year
- [EOT cranes](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/structural/eot-cranes/)
- [Access engineering](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/access/)

## Guides
- [Electro-forged or heavy duty grating: which one?](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/insights/efg-or-heavy-duty-grating/): How to choose between electro-forged and heavy duty welded steel grating: loads, bar sizes, spans and finishes, with the ranges Ferrotech makes in Oman.
- [What to put in a steel grating enquiry: a spec checklist](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/insights/steel-grating-enquiry-checklist/): A checklist for specifying steel grating in Oman and the GCC: standard, load bar, mesh, finish, panel size, cut-outs and quantity, with Ferrotech's options.
- [FRP or steel grating: choosing by environment](https://hharan.site/clients/demos/ferrotech/insights/frp-or-steel-grating/): When fibreglass (FRP / GRP) grating is the better choice than steel: corrosion, fire, weight and temperature, with the resin systems Ferrotech supplies in Oman.
